Thanks for the report. The key for looking up the SSL session is not initialized. Analysing...

Update: not the key is fine. The error happens when iterating over the peer slots. A slot should hold a key string or the key is NULL when the slot is free. But the slot key in the backtrace is `(char *)0x10` at index `35`. 

But unless Archlinux tweaked this, there should only be 25 slots. Hmm...
This is how the Arch package is built: https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/curl/-/blob/main/PKGBUILD.  There are currently no patches or backports applied.
@ghen2 thanks. So, the size if not tweaked, meaning this looks as if the session cache memory is messed up.

issue.title: Revert "curl: update to 8.12.0"
issue.body:
The new curl version causes crashes eg when downloading addons from the kodi repo.

Revert the bump until the issue is resolved

body: Can someone here build a curl from a PR to test with kodi? I see that kodi can use curl tracing and I could add some extra logs.

Without seeing any faults in the code, made #16240 where the SSL session cache carries a magic number during its lifetime and checks that during access.

I someone could take that for a spin with kodi that'd be very helpful. Best build the curl debug version, enable  curl logging in kodi and set the environment:

```
CURL_DEBUG=ssl,ssls
```

so we'll see SSL and SSL session cache operations. Thank you.

body:
Strangely, I can't reproduce the segfault with https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/16240/commits/eb89e25a968c70e015eb08dbd40ea22fa7d07316 applied...
When I revert to the original 8.12, it does crash.

> Strangely, I can't reproduce the segfault with [eb89e25](https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/eb89e25a968c70e015eb08dbd40ea22fa7d07316) applied... When I revert to the original 8.12, it does crash.

The magic number check prevents it probably from reaching that part now. The question is: does kodi release the curl multi_handle too early or is someone corrupting the memory.

But many thanks for testing this.

Also: are you testing with the curl debug version or plain?

Hi, Arch Linux curl maintainer here.
 
> Strangely, I can't reproduce the segfault with [eb89e25](https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/eb89e25a968c70e015eb08dbd40ea22fa7d07316) applied... When I revert to the original 8.12, it does crash.

Wonder if the bug is only appearing cause of compiler optimizations.

> Also: are you testing with the curl debug version or plain?

Arch publish -debug packages as well and one can simply use debuginfod to grab traces

https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Debuginfod
https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Debugging/Getting_traces
thanks for chiming in @inglor. something is fishy, for sure.
It's not exclusively an Arch issue though, see e.g. https://github.com/LibreELEC/LibreELEC.tv/pull/9772
@ghen2 trying to cover all bases here: did you build curl 8.12.0 with the patch from the PR or the complete PR branch (which includes other changes)?

No, curl 8.12.0 + just that one commit (https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/eb89e25a968c70e015eb08dbd40ea22fa7d07316 added to the `backports` array of the PKGBUILD).  + corresponding -debug package for backtrace.

> Wonder if the bug is only appearing cause of compiler optimizations.

I just tested with a locally built vanilla curl 8.12.0 package as well, and could trigger the segfault this time.

So it's not (just) the compiler flags / optimizations.  The same build with or without that commit doesn't / does crash.
